about: D-803 Terrace kit (tools/blender/terracekit.py): batch 1 the palaces' wall-head cornice and wall-foot plinth, batch 2 the stone window frame, batch 5 the building site (brick courses, stacks, putlog scaffold, ladder, cedar beam), modelled and AO-baked in Blender (Cycles, vertex AO); game axes (x along the wall 0..1 m, y up, z out of its face); c = paint (sRGB); tier C
